🔥 helix | Rust
🎯 Primary Use Case: A highly efficient and modern text editing experience for developers, particularly those who appreciate modal editing paradigms and advanced code intelligence.
✨ Key Features: • Vim-like modal editing • Multiple selections • Built-in language server support • Smart, incremental syntax highlighting and code editing via tree-sitter
📖 Summary: Helix is a post-modern modal text editor written in Rust, inspired by Kakoune and Neovim. It focuses on a unique editing model with multiple selections and integrates advanced features like built-in language server support and smart syntax highlighting via tree-sitter.
